description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures for OpenWrt firmware, including a placeholder check and an upgrade process that delegates to a default function based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check if the firmware image is suitable for upgrade, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the upgrade process, calls default upgrade method based on the board name.
